#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    std::string s;
    std::cin >> s;
    const char* chars = s.c_str();

    int ans = 0;
    int i = 0;
    while (i < s.length()) {
        char c = chars[i];
        int j = i;
        while (j < s.length() && chars[j] == c) {
            j++;
        }
        if (((j - i) & 1) == 0) {
            ans++;
        }
        i = j;
    }

    std::cout << ans << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
